title: Midpoint Calculator
description: Find the midpoint of a line segment in 2D or 3D by averaging the coordinates.
howto: Press Find midpoint to see the result and the averaging steps.

faqs.a: Average each coordinate: M = ((x₁+x₂)/2, (y₁+y₂)/2), and likewise for z in 3D.

faqs.q: Is the midpoint always between the points?
faqs.a: Yes — it is the exact center of the segment, equidistant from both endpoints.

faqs.q: Can I use it to bisect repeatedly?
faqs.a: Yes, applying it again to each half quarters the segment — the basis of binary search on a line.
